section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 3. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 10.4 | 5.2 | 600 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 10.1 | 5.0 | 600 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 10.4 | 5.2 | 600 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 10.6 | 5.3 | 600 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
